summary: Prompt MCP stdio upstream failure propagation

delivery.outcome: On configured Unix stdio clients, upstream denial or transport failure exits promptly while stdin stays open, using cancelable native pipe input and closed nonsecret diagnostics.
nonGoals: No gateway policy, credentials, providers, Platform, broker or shared service restart.

architecture.decision: Use asyncio native cancelable Unix pipe input with the existing MCP stdio parser/writer. Preserve non-Unix fallback and emit closed diagnostic categories at the CLI boundary.
architecture.rollback: Restore the prior isolated client runtime/config binding; do not change shared gateway.
